'''Cresh Krill Yirt''' was a series of [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] that featured [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] performing various kinds of daring stunts, which often ended in severe injuries. The individuals starring in those holovids had a cult-like following in the Xexto society, whose members were accustomed to a lifestyle of risk-taking.<ref name="Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Cresh/Legends|Cresh]], [[Krill/Legends|Krill]], and [[Yirt/Legends|Yirt]] are the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] equivalent of the Roman letters C, K, and Y.<ref name="GM Screen">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised]]''</ref> The Cresh Krill Yirt holovids feature individuals performing dangerous stunts.<ref name="Target" />
